page.content:
Asimov's psychohistory, Terminus, and the long fall of Empire.

How Foundation connects

  • Creator: Isaac Asimov — Isaac Asimov created the Foundation series.
  • Work: Foundation (book) — The 1951 book is the opening volume of Foundation.
  • Work: Foundation and Empire — Foundation and Empire is the second volume.
  • Work: Second Foundation — Second Foundation is the third volume of the original trilogy.
  • Series: Foundation (Apple series) — The Apple series is a screen sibling in the Foundation subject.

What is Foundation?

Foundation is Isaac Asimov's saga of Hari Seldon's psychohistory: a science that predicts the Galactic Empire's fall and plants a Foundation on Terminus to shorten the dark age. The books run through Foundation, Foundation and Empire, and Second Foundation; Apple's series is a later sibling adaptation.

Key threads lead to Isaac Asimov, Foundation (book), Foundation and Empire, Second Foundation and Foundation (Apple series).
